instructions_to_main_agent: Build a production-quality, responsive TonAer homepage with sticky navigation, video-first hero with teal cinematic gradient, editorial transition, AI network intelligence matrix, hardware ecosystem (5G/Wi-Fi 7/eSIM), large dashboard preview, network topology interconnect (gateway to client), operations & analytics, white-label platform management, and interactive contact modal. Use Tailwind CSS with primary color #00C7A5 and light background #F6F7F8. Ensure all interactive items have data-testid attributes.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes
Do not use universal transitions like transition: all
Never use complete transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or headers
Use Outfit for headers and Plus Jakarta Sans for body text
